=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py (live copy .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py):build_curl_command (`--noproxy *`) / resolve_target (`socket.getaddrinfo`) lines 156-235 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The helper resolves DNS in-process and disables proxies (`--noproxy "*"`), so it cannot fetch in proxy-only egress environments such as Claude Code web sessions, and the commands forbid falling back to curl.
  WHY: Every raw external fetch fails in a proxy-only session. Severity map: MAJOR from all five reviewers (maps to high). Confidence ranges from 3 to 4.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:fetch_url redirect loop / _run_single_hop / build_curl_command lines 288-380 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `--max-time` and the subprocess timeout apply per redirect hop and the loop has no overall deadline, so a fetch can run about 6 x 120 s (or about 21 x 120 s with 20 redirects) against the documented 120 s cap.
  WHY: The documented cap in the README, changelog and agents fragment is not enforced. Severity disagreement: NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, MAJOR from google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and minimax_minimax-m3. Highest is used.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:_run_single_hop lines 301-306 and build_curl_command `--max-filesize` lines 217-221 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: curl's `--max-filesize` does not bound chunked or length-unknown responses, and the helper checks the body size only after curl finishes writing.
  WHY: An unbounded stream can fill the temporary disk before the post-transfer check rejects it. Severity disagreement: NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, MAJOR from the other four. Highest is used.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:resolve_target / _resolve_argument lines 156-202 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: All DNS answers are validated but only the first is pinned via `--resolve`, so an unreachable first address (for example IPv6 with no route) makes curl exit 7 with no fallback.
  WHY: This is a reliability regression versus the replaced plain curl. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- .claude/commands/analyze-log.md, .claude/commands/apply-url.md, .claude/commands/investigate-issue.md (and workflow-templates twins):literal `python scripts/safe_fetch_url.py` | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The commands invoke `python`, which is absent on python3-only hosts, and they forbid a curl fallback.
  WHY: The first external fetch would fail with "python: command not found". Confidence ranges from 2 to 3.
- tests/test_safe_fetch_url.py:348-363 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_documented_invocation_finds_the_synced_helper` substitutes `sys.executable` for `python`, so the shipped `python` spelling is never executed in CI.
  WHY: A regression on python3-only hosts would go undetected. The anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewer also mentions this test within its python finding.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:build_curl_command lines 200-225 and line 305 (no `--compressed`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: curl runs without `--compressed`, so the size cap counts on-wire bytes rather than decoded size.
  WHY: Compressed content that is small on the wire could expand far past the cap downstream. The anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewer noted this only as a hardening suggestion and did not report it as a defect.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:384 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `os.replace` may fail with EXDEV if the output path is on a different filesystem than the temp file.
  WHY: The download could be reported as failed even though it succeeded. The same reviewer notes the temp file is created in `output_path.parent`.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:fetch_url lines 339-348 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Temp body and header files are created for every hop next to `--output`, so several near-cap temp files can coexist across redirects and concurrent downloads.
  WHY: The writable directory can fill up with confusing "no space left" errors before the documented cap applies.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:parse_https_url lines 109-148 and _create_temporary_path | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The helper writes to a caller-supplied absolute `--output` path with no check that it lies in an agent-controlled scratch directory.
  WHY: An attacker-influenced filename could cause a write to or overwrite of an unintended file.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:fetch_url lines ~336-345 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The helper unconditionally runs `destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)` before any URL validation.
  WHY: A reused `/tmp` output path loses the earlier file when a new fetch is refused.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:build_curl_command (`--noproxy *`) / resolve_target | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: DNS is resolved in-process and curl connects directly with proxies disabled, while CLAUDE.md §23 says direct egress is blocked in Claude Code web sessions.
  WHY: Every raw log, artifact and PDF fetch fails in a proxy-only session, and the commands give no alternative.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:fetch_url redirect `while True` loop, _run_single_hop (`timeout=limits.max_time + 5.0`), build_curl_command (`--max-time`) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `--max-time` and the subprocess timeout apply per hop with no overall deadline, against a documented "120 s by default" cap.
  WHY: A fetch can run about 6 x 120 s with the default redirects, or about 21 x 120 s with 20 redirects.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:_run_single_hop (`body_size > limits.max_bytes` check) with `--max-filesize` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `--max-filesize` does not stop chunked responses with no Content-Length, and the helper checks the size only after curl finishes.
  WHY: A fast host could fill the temp disk within the 120 s window before the helper rejects the body.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:resolve_target (`validated_addresses[0]`) / _resolve_argument | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every DNS answer is validated but only the first is pinned.
  WHY: With a first AAAA answer and no IPv6 route, curl exits 7 with no fallback, a reliability regression.
- .claude/commands/analyze-log.md, .claude/commands/apply-url.md, .claude/commands/investigate-issue.md and the three workflow-templates copies:`(cd .claude && python scripts/safe_fetch_url.py ...)` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The commands call `python`, and the test substitutes `sys.executable`, so the shipped spelling is never exercised.
  WHY: On a host with only `python3` the first external fetch fails; the reviewer could not confirm that any target environment lacks `python`.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (1) compute one overall `deadline` in `fetch_url` and pass the remaining time to each hop, or reword the docs to "per request" (6-8 lines); (2) keep curl without `--compressed` and state that in a comment (1-2 lines); (3) return all validated addresses and emit one `--resolve` per address (8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:301-306 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `--max-filesize` check runs only after the download completes (`body_path.stat().st_size`).
  WHY: Unbounded chunked data could exhaust disk space before curl exits or the size is inspected.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:357-380 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `max_time` timeout is applied per redirect hop, not to the whole fetch.
  WHY: Five redirects at close to 120 s each exceed the documented 120 s limit by several minutes.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:156, 214 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script uses `socket.getaddrinfo` and `--resolve` pinning but does not handle proxy-only egress environments.
  WHY: Direct connections are blocked in environments like Claude Code on the web, and the commands forbid falling back to curl, so external fetches fail entirely.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:181 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `resolve_target` validates multiple DNS results but pins only the first.
  WHY: An unreachable first address (for example IPv6 on a dual-stack host) fails with curl exit 7, where the old curl would have fallen back.
- .claude/commands/analyze-log.md, .claude/commands/apply-url.md, .claude/commands/investigate-issue.md (and workflow-templates copies):`python scripts/safe_fetch_url.py` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The commands invoke `python` instead of `python3`.
  WHY: Many environments ship only `python3`, so the fetch fails with "python: command not found" and curl fallback is forbidden.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:384 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `os.replace` requires source and destination on the same filesystem, but the temp file is created in `destination.parent`.
  WHY: The reviewer claims a different mount could raise EXDEV and fail a successful download.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:305 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: curl is invoked without `--compressed`, so `--max-filesize` counts compressed size.
  WHY: A compressed payload could expand beyond the expected limits once decoded.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:build_curl_command lines 200-235 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Connections are pinned to a single validated IP with `--noproxy '*'`, so networks that require a proxy cannot reach the destination, and the commands forbid a curl fallback.
  WHY: Sessions without direct port-443 egress cannot use the helper at all; the hard-coded `--noproxy` overrides the environment.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:_run_single_hop lines 288-305, redirect loop lines 357-380, README.md:1517, changelog.d/8323-safe-fetch-url-commands.md:11 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `--max-time` is per curl hop with no overall deadline, so the default 5 redirects allow about 12 minutes and 20 redirects about 24 minutes against an advertised 120 s cap.
  WHY: A slow server can block `/analyze-log` and `/investigate-issue` far past the documented budget.
- .claude/scripts/safe_fetch_url.py:build_curl_command line 217 (`--max-filesize`) and post-hop size check lines 301-302 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `--max-filesize` only triggers on a known Content-Length, so a chunked response can stream past the 100 MiB cap before the post-hoc check.
  WHY: The temp file can grow unbounded and exhaust disk.
